picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, unveiled at the National Academy of Engineering meeting, would link national supercomputers, datasets, and experimental facilities into a unified AI-for-science infrastructure — a flagship federal initiative with the scale to reshape research computing nationally.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: CERN's strategic partnership with Mistral to build a foundation model trained on billions of simulated particle collisions marks a major convergence of frontier AI labs and big-science infrastructure, with potential to accelerate discovery across particle physics.
picks.title: CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science – Home

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced consortium of 14+ universities led in part by Vanderbilt to build shared superintelligence computing infrastructure signals a coordinated regional response to the national AI compute race.
picks.title: Vanderbilt among founding members of Southeast Regional SI Computing Consortium

picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's claim of an autonomous multi-agent system producing a proof addressing part of the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize problem would be a landmark result for AI-assisted mathematics, if it holds up to scrutiny.
picks.title: Solução de problema matemático: como a IA está impactando a ciência? - Jornal da Unicamp

picks.title: Brown scholar to play key role in federally funded project to prevent neurodegenerative disease
